notes.title: Release Announcement: Crazy Robot Ball Now Available
notes.notes:
[b]Crazy Robot Ball Is Officially Released![/b]

Get ready to experience the ultimate fusion of strategy and chaos! Crazy Robot Ball is a turn-based robot football game where you assemble a team of unique robots. Outsmart opponents, master different arenas, and score your way to the top in this thrilling competition for the Golden Trophy!

[b]Watch the Trailer:[/b]
[previewyoutube=EhcBNfJ8jWc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Buy Now and Join the Game![/b]

Take control, plan your moves, and dominate the field—Crazy Robot Ball is available now.

[b]Thank you for your support[/b]

notes.title: Crazy Robot Ball Launches This Monday!
notes.notes:
[b]Crazy Robot Ball Launches Monday, May 5th![/b]
After months of development, we're beyond excited to finally share [i]Crazy Robot Ball[/i] with the world! The game officially releases this [b]Monday, May 5th[/b], and we can't wait for you to experience the chaos, challenge, and fun we've packed into it.

To get a taste of what’s coming, check out the official release trailer:
[previewyoutube=EhcBNfJ8jWc;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven’t already, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400150/Crazy_Robot_Ball/]wishlist the game now[/url][/b] – it really helps us out and ensures you don’t miss the launch.
Thanks for all the support so far – we’re counting down the days. See you Monday!
